budget_rationale: Finite48GiB/4h owned-process allowance for first same-source243-file Q8 top synthesis including physical netlist diagnostics. It is a cap, not a duration prediction or resource estimate. Source has eight20992x16 Ws banks and substantial other storage; prior old-kernel timings/resources do not establish this identity. 192GiB MemAvailable reserve remains enforced. No unbounded run or retry.

policy.concurrency: Root hands single heavy Laya slot; no concurrent CPU/RTL/HLS/OOC tool.
policy.stop: Any clone/binding/source/tool/guard failure stops sequence; preserve partial evidence, actualfirstfatal and anyDCP. No same-run/unchanged retry, extra synthesis or budget increase. A Ws report failure after DCP does not justify rerunning successful synthesis.
policy.post: Rehash original366,a2tree438,all bound source/guard scripts,clone243compiled inputs and original/staged model inputs. Cloneproject state/log/cache may mutate as expected; archive exact before/after XPR and addedfiles. Any source/IP/config/compile drift invalidates same-source claim until reviewed. Preserve all earlier project failures.

Ws_acceptance_obligations.logical_capacity: 8banks*20992words*16bits=2686976bits=335872bytes. Each bank must preserve required rows0..20991, including high segment16384..20991. HLS64BRAM18 total is not enough by itself to establish capacity.
Ws_acceptance_obligations.primitive_inventory: Identify every physical storageprimitive per logicalbank (BRAM/URAM/LUTRAM/FF/SRL as applicable), configured read/write widths/depths,cascades and storagebit ownership. Count dual-port cells once and use effective data capacity, not rawdevice total or unrelated FF/LUT logic. Any omitted/constant/truncated bank/bit requires a source-grounded explanation.
Ws_acceptance_obligations.address_proof: Trace both logical address0/read and address1/write bits0..14 through actual synthesized decode/enable/WE/storageaddress and read selection. Specifically establish independent storage selection above16383 through20991; a connected bit14 or primitive count alone is not enough. Retain decode/port-net evidence and use savedDCP for later focused inspection if reports are insufficient.
Ws_acceptance_obligations.first_review: Return DCP,Wsallprimitive/refcounts/pins/address-controlfanout/unmapped records and synthesistrim/initwarnings. The reviewer separately determines capacity/high-address acceptance. If this cannot be established, result remains REVIEW_REQUIRED even if synth/tool exit0. No empirical capacity claim from this source-only gate.
